text:
maria: Heads up — the nightly benchmark cron (nightly-bench@03:30) is red this morning, ~40 failing tests across the latency suite. Noticed a cluster of failures around kv cache stress and timeouts. Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/2145001234

ci-bot: build #7864 failed on runner gpu-24. Summary: 39 failed, 3 flaky, 1 infra. Failures start at run_tests::bench_inference_latency_test::test_kv_cache_stress (timeout after 300s)

colin: ugh. any recent changes touching kv cache or scheduler?

sam: @maria i merged a small scheduling tweak yesterday that could change batch lifetimes — PR 4821. It was low-risk but maybe interacting with long sequences.

jen: i'm kicking off a rerun of the nightly job for the same commit to confirm flakiness: `/rerun nightly-bench 2145001234` — triggered at 03:55. Will post link.

ops-bot: rerun started: https://ci.internal.redwood/2145001234/rerun-1 (runner gpu-36)

maria: thanks jen. if rerun stays green we probably have a flaky. if it fails again we should bisect. can someone check node metrics (OOMs, preempts)?

ops-bot: node gpu-24 had a transient preemption event at 03:22 (kube-scheduler evict). No OOMs reported. CPU spiked on bench-master for a short window.

colin: copying the failing log snippet in case it's helpful:
```
E 03:20:12 bench_inference_latency_test.py:372 - AssertionError: avg_latency=512.3ms exceeds threshold 200ms
W 03:20:10 kv_cache.py:128 - cache_miss_ratio=0.72, rebuilds=3
E 03:20:11 runtime_pool.py:54 - schedule timeout after 300s waiting for slot
```

sam: PR 4821 touched runtime_pool backoff heuristics — i'll revert the tiny change locally and run the bench suite against that commit in a /try to see if it reproduces.

jen: rerun finished: https://ci.internal.redwood/2145001234/rerun-1 — result: 27 failures (reduced). Several same tests still failing, so looks non-deterministic but repeatable.

maria: ok. action plan: 1) colin to bisect between last-green and current to narrow offending commit (assigning) 2) sam to run the bench locally with PR4821 reverted and report by EOD 3) jen will schedule a targeted job that pins to a different runner pool (gpu-36) to rule out node variance

colin: starting bisect now — bisecting commits 9a1f2..HEAD. will post smallest failing commit and a short repro. ETA ~45m.

sam: local quick check shows kv cache rebuild path increases under synthetic load with PR4821 off by ~2x, can reproduce with `make bench-run ARGS=--stress-kv`. Sharing artifact shortly.

maria: thanks. if bisect points to the scheduling change we can either revert or add a guard in runtime_pool to avoid starving long-running batches. I'll create the rollback PR template prefilled so we can move fast.

maria: tagging this for follow-up in tomorrow standup. If anything becomes critical ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
